name: connected_http_request
title: GitHub API request (as me)
description:
Call a read-only GitHub REST API endpoint (api.github.com) as the signed-in user, through their connected GitHub account. This is an administrator binding of the generic connected_http_request implementation: GET only, and only paths under /user, /users, /repos, /orgs, /search, /notifications or /issues.
Returns: status (HTTP code), ok, content_type and body (parsed JSON, or text up to 20,000 characters).
Inputs (* required): path* (absolute API path starting with /, e.g. /user/repos or /repos/octocat/hello-world/pulls; no .. or //); method (GET only; default GET); query (object of query parameters, e.g. {"per_page": 50}); body (ignored for GET).
For the common cases use github_list_my_repos or github_create_issue. Runs only for a signed-in SAJHA user; when the account is not linked, or lacks the scope, the call returns a request to connect it with a link instead of a result.
Example: {"path": "/repos/octocat/hello-world/issues", "query": {"state": "open", "per_page": 20}}

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Generic binding: the implementation reads http.base_url, http.methods and http.paths from this file; the token only ever goes to the provider's api_hosts.
